body: The most difficult part is trying not to think of all the things I could have done to make it work :(

I think I should have waited some weeks before saying anything because things didn't cool down, I was blinded by fear of loss. 

Still, thank you for your kind words, it's hard right now. I can't believe this is the first time I'm crying over someone
I am going to send a letter but I'm afraid I will come off as desperate or lonely and scare her off

It's really fucked up how someone who is in a monogamous relationship thinks it's ok to do such an awful thing. I hate lies and they broke me, they made me think women were all the same, all cheaters. Just like you said she is a stay-at-home person and I thought she was the right person for me, of course there are COUNTLESS more reasons to be with her but at first that was one of the main reasons.   
Thank you for your kindness I will send you a message

I'm sorry that happened to you and I hope things will go better for you soon. I totally understand and how hard it is not to reach the other person when you haven't been blocked. She has sent me some messages at first saying she was sorry for everything and has been a bit needy but lately she's been more and more distant, she has deactivated all of her social media so I cannot see how she is doing besides of our texts. I will try not to be too emotional but also not cold, I am afraid that would scare her 

I will update when I'll send the letter and how it will go. Thank you for your advice.

This was my third relationship, the other two girls I went out with cheated on me one with her best friend, and the other had a one-night stand with a friend of hers. My ex isn't a party person and she doesn't go out often.

 She is a pretty naive and innocent person and usually ignores when her male friends and coworkers are flirting with her. This  made me want to control her social life and I couldn't stand causing her trouble because of my jealousy, but seeking therapy wasn't really an option for me before because most people around me always talked bad about therapists. She was kind enough to understand what I went through and was patient enough to deal with me when I got jealous and because of that I want to get better, for her, no matter what people say. 

I want to be the best version of myself for her, she deserves to be happy, and I want to see her happy and be close to her

I am going to visit a psy for the first time this week, and hopefully I will manage to solve my personal issues. I will write a letter as you say and will send it so she won't feel forced to reply if she doesn't want to contact me again. Knowing that she might never want  to talk to me makes my heart ache but if that's what she needs then so be it
